title: NOAA APT Pass SNR Trend
dataSources: FT8 spots (`ft8:spot`), JS8Call messages (`js8call:message`), PSKReporter receptions (`pskreporter:spot`), Direwolf TNC telemetry (`direwolf:packet`), and NOAA APT pass events (`noaaapt:pass`).
app: Weak-signal and decoder telemetry from WSJT-X FT8, JS8Call, PSKReporter, Direwolf TNC, NOAA APT pass schedulers, and station-control scripts sent to Splunk HEC via APIs, ADIF/log exports, and MQTT.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=noaaapt:pass
| bin _time span=1d
| stats avg(pass_snr_db) as avg_pass_snr_db max(pass_snr_db) as max_pass_snr_db by _time satellite
| sort - _time
description: Tracks NOAA APT pass SNR over time and breaks it out by satellite.
value: SNR trends show whether antenna position, receiver health, or weather are changing decode quality over time.
implementation: Send NOAA APT pass SNR events to `index=personal` with the fields used in the breakdown and review the resulting trend at 1d granularity.
visualization: Stacked time chart of NOAA APT pass SNR by satellite.
grandmaExplanation: It reminds how NOAA APT pass SNR changes over time so the busy spells and quiet spells stand out.
